bands.title: Where Engineering Excellence Meets Data & AI Specialization
Our Story
bands.lead: Ignitho was founded in 2016 with a simple thesis: large enterprises are drowning in technology, not because they lack tools, but because no one is making the tools they already own work together effectively. The large SIs handle the macro strategy. The hyperscalers sell the platforms. Nobody was systematically solving the execution gap – the pipeline reliability, the analytics that never get used, the AI that never leaves the Jupyter notebook. Ignitho was built to own that gap

items.title: Non-disruptive by design
items.body: We complement your existing vendors and internal teams. No rip-and-replace. No disruptive change management programs

items.title: Day-1 Productive teams
items.body: Senior practitioners who know Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS better than most internal teams. No ramp-up theatre. No hand-holding

items.title: Frugal Innovation principle
items.body: Grounded in Cambridge research. Maximum impact from existing investments. No new licensing. No tool bloat. Lower total cost of outcome

items.title: Outcomes, not activity
items.body: Measured by business results, not hours billed. Every sprint closes with a deployed, tested, business-ready deliverable

items.title: Global delivery, local presence
items.body: US HQ in Tampa. On-the-ground presence in the UK, Sweden, India, and Costa Rica. Flex onshore/offshore/hybrid to match your governance model

items.title: Enterprise-grade security
items.body: ISO 27001 certified. SOC 2 compliant. Robust data privacy controls for GDPR and HIPAA regulated environments
